description.fun: Honedge is a haunted sword, said to be born when a departed spirit takes over the blade that killed it long ago. Grab it by the hilt and it wraps its blue sash around your arm and drains your life energy. The eye on its handguard is its true body, and the scabbard's carvings only make it look like it has a face. It may draw on the tsukumogami of Japanese legend, forgotten objects that come to life.
description.guide: Honedge is a Steel- and Ghost-type Pokémon from Kalos that looks like a medieval sword possessed by a spirit. It holds its sheath with its prehensile sash and drains the life of anyone foolish enough to grip its hilt. It evolves into Doublade and then Aegislash.
description.tagline: A haunted sword that drains whoever grabs its hilt

description.fun: Doublade is two haunted swords that talk to each other telepathically, weaving attacks so intricate that even master swordsmen can't block them. Rubbing its blades together makes a metallic screech that unnerves foes. It's the only Ghost-type Pokémon made of more than one body, and with its crossed swords on a shared plaque it looks like a coat of arms come to life.
description.guide: Doublade is a Steel- and Ghost-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Honedge's line, made up of two possessed swords. The blades communicate telepathically to make complex attacks that are hard to defend against. It is the only Ghost-type Pokémon made of multiple bodies.
description.tagline: Two telepathic swords whose combo can't be blocked

description.fun: Aegislash is a kingmaker: legend says whoever it recognises as a born leader is destined to rule, and it has served generations of kings. Its spectral power once forced people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking, and one Aegislash drained a king's life and brought his kingdom down with him. In battle it switches between guarding behind its shield and swinging its golden blade.
description.guide: Aegislash is a Steel- and Ghost-type Pokémon, the final form of Honedge, resembling a golden sword and shield. It is said to recognise people with the qualities of a king, and has served royal lines for generations. In battle it changes between Shield Forme for defence and Blade Forme for attacking.
description.tagline: A golden sword and shield that chooses who becomes king

description.fun: Its attacking stance: Aegislash moves its shield to one arm and bares its blade, using the blade's weight to cut through anything. It switches back to Shield Forme with the move King's Shield.
